IA No.2 of 2026 for Money Withdrawal Application
In
AO No.459 of 2025
The Oriental Insurance Company Limited .....Appellant
v.
Vikram Singh and Others ....Respondents
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. M.K. Goyal, Advocate for the appellant,
through video conferencing.
Mr. Yogesh Upadhyay, Advocate for the
respondent nos.1 and 2 ("the claimants").
Heard.
The respondent nos. 1 and 2 are being
represented. The respondent no.3 was earlier
represented.
Service is sufficient on the respondent
no.5, but service is not sufficient on the
respondent no.4.
Let issue fresh notices to the respondent
no.04, returnable within six weeks.
Steps to be taken within a week.
List after service report is received.
In case steps are not taken, the appeal
shall stand dismissed without reference to the
Court.
Heard on IA No.02 of 2026 for Money
Withdrawal Application
The present appeal against order is
preferred against the judgment and award dated
19.09.2025, passed in MACP No.380 of 2022,
Vikram Singh and Another v. Arun and others,
by the court of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/I
Additional District Judge, Kashipur, District
Udham Singh Nagar. By it, the appellant was
required to pay compensation to the respondent

nos. 1 and 2/claimants. Now the money
withdrawal application has been filed by the
claimant.
On 02.01.2026, when the appeal was
admitted, the appellant was required to deposit
the entire awarded amount, which has now been
deposited. Now the claimants have filed an
application for withdrawal of the money.
Having heard, let 50 per cent of the
deposited amount be remitted in favour of the
claimants. The amount may be straightway
transmitted to their respective bank accounts.
The bank accounts shall be verified first,
and only thereafter, the amount shall be
deposited in their accounts.
The money withdrawal application is
decided, accordingly.
 (Ravindra Maithani J.)
 03.07.2026
